description: Implement real frame preview using ffmpeg subprocess extraction. Replace placeholder rectangles with actual video frame rendering in all 4 display modes (side-by-side, overlay, wiper, checkerboard). Add extract_frame method to pipeline_adapter.py.
steps: Add extract_frame(path, frame_number, width) -> QImage | None to pipeline_adapter.py using ffmpeg subprocess with RGB24 rawvideo pipe output
Rewrite preview_panel.py to use real frame extraction instead of placeholder text
Implement all 4 display modes: side-by-side (two QLabels), overlay (QPainter blend), wiper (vertical divider), checkerboard (64x64 blocks)
Add zoom fit and zoom 100% with scroll support
Implement 3-frame cache (current +/- 1) to limit RAM usage
Apply sync offset: HDR frame = current_frame, OM frame = current_frame + offset
acceptance_criteria: extract_frame returns QImage from ffmpeg subprocess or None on failure
ffmpeg located via backend MediaToolLocator, PATH fallback, then Windows hardcoded paths
All 4 preview modes render real frames when sources are loaded
Frame navigation triggers real extraction for both HDR and OM sources
Sync offset applied to OM frame number
All Python files pass AST validation
verification: Run: find gui/ -name '*.py' -exec python3 -c 'import ast, sys; ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1]).read())' {} \;
Verify extract_frame method exists in pipeline_adapter.py
Verify preview_panel.py uses extract_frame and implements all 4 modes
